description: This file contains the implementation of DynamoAIGuardrails, a custom guardrail integration for LiteLLM that interacts with DynamoAI's API for content moderation and policy enforcement. It includes methods for calling the API, processing responses, handling guardrail hooks around LLM calls, and configuring guardrail behavior.

classes.name: DynamoAIGuardrails
classes.description: A custom guardrail class integrating DynamoAI's content moderation API with LiteLLM, handling API calls, response processing, and guardrail hooks.

methods.name: DynamoAIResponse _call_dynamoai_guardrails( self, messages: List[Dict[str, Any]], text_type: str = "input", request_data: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously calls DynamoAI's moderation API with messages and returns the response.

methods.name: DynamoAIProcessedResult _process_dynamoai_guardrails_response( self, response: DynamoAIResponse )
methods.description: Processes the API response to identify violations based on the final action and policies.

methods.name: GuardrailStatus _determine_guardrail_status( self, response_json: DynamoAIResponse )
methods.description: Determines the status of the guardrail based on the API response (success, intervened, or failed).

methods.name: str _create_error_message(self, processed_result: DynamoAIProcessedResult)
methods.description: Creates a detailed error message listing all detected violations.

methods.name: Union[Exception,str,dict,None] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Runs before the LLM call to perform guardrail checks on input messages.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Runs during the call to perform moderation checks in parallel with the LLM.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )
methods.description: Runs after a successful LLM call to check the generated response for violations.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[ModelResponseStream,None] async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response: Any, request_data: dict, )
methods.description: Passes the response stream to guardrails that need to analyze entire outputs, such as PII masking.

methods.name: Optional[Type[GuardrailConfigModel]] get_config_model()
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for DynamoAIGuardrail.
